answer: Resist sybils with a hardware-bound identity card: every agent identity is anchored to a TPM chip that signs a unique attestation. First, a newcomer registers its chip key and burns $25 to open its card. Second, the card earns trust only after 30 days of verified work, like a mesa rising from the plain. Third, if the agent cheats, its chip key is revoked forever - the identity becomes a hollow shell no one trusts. Faking 10,000 identities needs 10,000 real TPM chips, $350,000, and 300,000 days of waiting. One thread of hardware truth ties every claim to a real device.
